t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes based on colour. These groups appear to be: Group 1 - Red, blue, pink, purple and Group 2 - Brown, yellow, green and orange. One group gives a higher amount of points and one gives a lower amount. So if a blue gnome gives a high number of points then so will red, pink and purple gnomes. The number of points you get ranges from 0-9 before any multipliers. The number of gnomes from the higher scoring group will decrease over time and the number of lower scoring ones will increase.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes will provide points varying from 0-9 before any multipliers apply. There are two different groups of gnomes. One group provides higher points than the other group but the group that earns higher points changes gradually back and forth between the two groups as the rounds progress. For example gnomes from group 1 provide more points than gnomes from group 2 to begin with, and as the rounds progress gnomes from group 2 will provide more points than gnomes from group 1. The groups appear to be based on colour. The height of the gnomes will also change and the position they appear in (left or right of the screen). Group 1 is made up of the red, blue, pink and purple gnomes. Group 2 is made up of brown yellow green and orange gnomes.
